context: Ren and Mei talk through a hard week.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ひどい/逃げ/ほんとう/聴く/ブルー) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今週、ほんとうに大変だったよ。
lines.style: tired young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひどく疲れた顔してるね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直、逃げ出したくなったよ。
lines.en: Honestly, I wanted to run away.
lines.style: honest young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 逃げずに頑張ったの、えらいよ。
lines.en: Not running and pushing through — that's admirable.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 気分が、ずっとブルーだったんだ。
lines.en: I'd been feeling blue the whole time.
lines.style: downcast young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 好きな音楽でも、聴こうよ。
lines.en: Let's listen to some music you like.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 音楽を聴くと、ほんとう落ち着くよ。
lines.en: Listening to music really calms me.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ブルーな気分、一緒に晴らそうね。
lines.en: Let's clear away that blue mood together.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
